title-group.article-title: Compound X reduces IL-6 in AD mouse models

abstract.p: Compound X reduced IL-6 in APP/PS1 mice compared with vehicle.

sec.title: Methods
sec.p: APP/PS1 mice received Compound X at 10 mg/kg for 8 weeks.

sec.title: Results
sec.p: IL-6 decreased by 32% after Compound X treatment.
